CaptureConfig.description: Timing of one TCS3448 capture cycle.

captures.description: Captures in acquisition order, each with its own timing; at least one dark. data m.tcs3448 holds one capture per step, in this order.
captures.title: Captures

CaptureConfig.title: CaptureConfig

CaptureStep.description:
One capture of the cycle and its timing. The fields are in the time order of the
phases: gap (all LEDs off), settle (LED on), delay (LED off), then the integration,
with the LED on for on_ms after its start. The LED never switches during an
integration, so a gated capture (delay_ms > 0) integrates entirely in the dark.

ill.description: LED of this capture; dark means none.
ill.title: Ill

gap_ms.description: All LEDs off before this capture starts; the dark time of a dark capture.
gap_ms.title: Gap Ms

settle_ms.description: LED on before the integration starts.
settle_ms.title: Settle Ms

delay_ms.description: LED off between the end of settle_ms and the integration start. 0: the LED stays on into the integration; > 0: gated capture, integrating the light that lingers after the pulse.
delay_ms.title: Delay Ms

on_ms.description: LED on after the integration starts.
on_ms.title: On Ms

CaptureStep.title: CaptureStep

GainControl.description: How the run picks the gain of each capture.

mode.description: fixed: every capture uses the gain its profile names. ams: the auto-gain search of ams AN001051, per illumination from one cycle to the next. dark: the gain of each lit capture predicted from the most recent dark capture before it in the cycle and the LED's share in the previous cycle.
mode.title: Mode

stages.description: Gain indices the regulation may choose from, ascending; every capture gain of the run is one of them. null exactly when mode is fixed.
stages.title: Stages

GainControl.title: GainControl

RunConfig.description:
Measurement settings of a run, resolved from its profile. Also the value type of the
device's profile file.
RunConfig.title: RunConfig

RunEndRecord.description:
End of a run; sent after its last data record, in the same boot as the start record.
Its up is greater than or equal to, and its seq greater than, those of the start
record. This relates two records, so the models cannot check it.

v.description: Version of the schema. Increased only on breaking changes.
v.title: V

fw.description: Firmware version (optionally containing the git commit hash)
fw.title: Fw

boot.description: Boot counter, stored on flash memory of the microcontroller.
boot.title: Boot

run.description: ID of the run that starts or ends.
run.title: Run

seq.description: Sequence number per record kind, for dedup (QoS 1, SD replay) and gap detection per kind. For data it counts per run and restarts at 0 with every run; for all other kinds it counts per boot. Unique key: (dev, run, seq) for data, (dev, boot, k, seq) for all other kinds.
seq.title: Seq

up.description: Monotonic seconds since boot, ms resolution. Time of measurement/event, not of sending. Use for intervals: ts may jump on re-sync.
up.title: Up

ts.description: Unix seconds UTC after NTP sync, captured together with up. null while unsynced; key is mandatory.
ts.title: Ts

cmd_id.description: id of the cmd that stopped the run; null if not ended by a command.
cmd_id.title: Cmd Id

reason.description: Why the run ended: duration elapsed, manual stop (command or on the device), or error in the firmware. A run without an end record is marked aborted by the pipeline; the device never sends that.
reason.title: Reason

n_data.description: Number of data records produced in this run. data seq starts at 0, so the run's data seq values are 0 to n_data - 1.
n_data.title: N Data

RunEndRecord.title: RunEndRecord

v.title: V

fw.description: Firmware version (optionally containing the git commit hash)
fw.title: Fw

boot.description: Boot counter, stored on flash memory of the microcontroller.
boot.title: Boot

run.description: ID of the run that starts or ends.
run.title: Run

seq.description: Sequence number per record kind, for dedup (QoS 1, SD replay) and gap detection per kind. For data it counts per run and restarts at 0 with every run; for all other kinds it counts per boot. Unique key: (dev, run, seq) for data, (dev, boot, k, seq) for all other kinds.
seq.title: Seq

up.description: Monotonic seconds since boot, ms resolution. Time of measurement/event, not of sending. Use for intervals: ts may jump on re-sync.
up.title: Up

ts.description: Unix seconds UTC after NTP sync, captured together with up. null while unsynced; key is mandatory.
ts.title: Ts

dur.description: Planned duration; null = unlimited, runs until stopped.
dur.title: Dur

session.description: Session this run belongs to, taken from the start command; null if none.
session.title: Session

cmd_id.description: id of the cmd that started the run; null if started on the device.
cmd_id.title: Cmd Id

profile.description: Profile the run measures with: the one named in the start command, or the device's default profile if the command named none or the run was started on the device.
profile.title: Profile

cfg.description: Settings of profile as resolved at the start, fixed for the whole run. Read these instead of the profile file, which may have changed since.
